# JAB Code runtime

`jabcodeJSLib.min.js` is the prebuilt browser distribution from
[TMSSassen/JABCodeJS](https://github.com/TMSSassen/JABCodeJS), which wraps the
Fraunhofer SIT JAB Code implementation. It is loaded by `jab-transfer.js` and
used for both encoding and decoding the visual frames.

The bundled distribution and its upstream notices are retained here. See
`JABCodeJS-LICENSE.MD` and `jabcodeJSLib.min.js.LICENSE.txt`.
